about: Napominalochka helps you remember what matters. Create reminders in the Mini App or chat, mark them done, and choose how often to be reminded.
calendar.instructions:
📅 Your private calendar link:
{webcal}

Subscribe once to see reminders in your phone’s calendar, with offline alarms at the scheduled time, then after 5 and 10 minutes. Changes normally appear within about 15 minutes.

iPhone: Settings → Calendar (Apps → Calendar on iOS 18) → Accounts → Add Account → Other → Add Subscribed Calendar. Turn OFF “Remove Alerts”.

Google Calendar (web): Other calendars → + → From URL:
{url}
Google refreshes only every few hours and may not alert you.

Keep the link private: anyone with it can see your reminders. Tap “New link” to revoke it.
